text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa isn't looking well, so I
take her
to the infirmary to get some
rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll get some sleep.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama, where have you been? I was
waiting
so long, I could count the
minutes past on one
hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Golshi... That means you were hardly
waiting at
all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's not argue semantics. Here, look! I
have
present for ya! Quick! Hurry up and
open it now!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? What're you planning?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I have no idea what you're talking
about! It's
just a regular, ordinary,
run-of-the-mill present!
You know, just
some homemade sushi!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. You're a terrible bluff.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you, there's definitely a catch,
but I'll
indulge you for the fun of it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What?! Golshi turned into me?!

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha! That worked perfectly! Now I
just need
to win a game of Old Maid,
and this body will be
mine for eternity!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Like hell! First off, if you're gonna look
like me,
then you better talk like me!

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. If you don't like it, then face
me! You
can even draw first if you want.

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oops! I have another pair! This is so easy
I'm
yawning!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(She didn't draw the Old Maid again... I
thought I
set it up perfectly...)

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're thinking you had me that time! I
see right
through you!

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Because I'm Nakayama Festa too!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Figures, using that body, you're
capable of
reading my mind...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But you haven't read my hand. Take a
look at
your cards.

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ack! I drew two cards?! Wait... You
made me mess
up, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I had an inkling you could read my
thoughts
earlier on. You're me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're both in the exact same situation.
We've
gotta both read and deceive each
other.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. That was electrifying... What
an
awesome dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her exciting dream, Nakayama
Festa is
able to get back on track!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm... What's up with this box? It won't
open.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It won't? Hand it over... Ngh! Seriously?!
Is it
broken?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm not the one who brought it
here. Grrr! It
won't even budge!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was I dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I wish I got to know what was in
that box!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's condition doesn't
improve,
perhaps due to her having a
disappointing dream.
